name: targets
note: Second-round probe for the commands that were no-ops in tactical-3 because their target object was absent, not because the command does nothing. 3D6F now uses operands that exist in this stage's part table with bit 2 already set (19, 773, 775 — verified from the tactical-3 part_instances capture; the earlier 53/874 were absent). 3D70 is preceded by 3D5A the way every one of the ten original instances is: the companion actor (183 チャム / 182 シルキー) has no deployment record anywhere and is registered with unit 999, so 3D5A is what puts it in the pilot table that 800ACFAC searches (stride 0x4C, actor at +2, requires +0x37 non-zero and a pointer at +0x38). 3D63 and 3D69 get a second look with actors that are present.

deployments.note: ショウ / ビルバイン — 3D70 first operand
豹馬 / コン・バトラーV — 3D63, 3D69
万丈 / ダイターン3 — 3D6B with a deployed subject

commands.note: probe A: number 19 is part entry 83 with +0x22 = 0x0C (bit 2 set)
probe B: number 773 is part entry 63, also 0x0C
probe C: number 775 is part entry 64, also 0x0C
probe D: register チャム with unit 999, the shape the original scripts use for a companion that never deploys
probe E: the dominant original instance, now with both actors in the pilot table
probe F: repeat with 豹馬 deployed, isolated from the other unit commands
probe G: value 1 on a deployed actor whose +0x35 has not been touched this run
